subject: Commitment and Capacity Plan for 32k Model + Reranker Add-on
messages:
From: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@mireo.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@mireo.com>
Date: 2027-10-28T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + new model mix — rough numbers

Hi Priya,

We’re starting our renewal discussions for the platform footprint that goes live in Q1. Two material changes on our side: we plan to pilot a larger 32k-context model for user-facing personalization, and we want to add a reranker workflow for search relevance (expected to run on 1.5x tokens per request). Combined this will increase peak token throughput and memory requirements.

Rough ask: 8x H100-equivalent GPUs reserved for steady-state, ability to burst to 12 for peak windows, and a 99.9% latency SLO for the personalization endpoints. We have a procurement window in November and need a committed plan and rough quote to include in the purchase request.

Can you share a proposal for capacity (pool sizing, GPU mix), any recommended model quantization/packing suggestions, and estimated monthly committed spend?

Thanks,
Asha
Asha Reddy
Head of Platform, Mireo Commerce

--

From: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@mireo.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-29T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + new model mix — rough numbers

Hi Asha — great context, thanks.

High-level recommendation (quick summary):
- Dedicated Reserved Pool: 8x H100-equivalent GPUs as committed baseline; burst pool up to 12 GPUs during peak windows.
- Model mix: run redwood-xl-32k for personalization (FP16 + GPTQ-lite quantization) and use a smaller 8k-optimized model for fallbacks. Reranker will be provisioned on a separate pool (2x A100-equivalent) to avoid tail latency impacting personalization traffic.
- Throughput guarantee: we can contract for a 99.9% latency SLO at the committed baseline with automatic fallback routing to the 8k model when burst capacity is exhausted.
- Term: 12-month renewal with quarterly performance review and a 4% annual escalator in committed spend; volume discounts tiered at 12/24/36-month prepay.

I’ve attached a throughput calculation workbook and a draft SOW that lays out pooling, canary rollout plan, and acceptance criteria. Ben / Monica: can you confirm pricing and whether we should propose H100-only or mixed H100/A100 for cost efficiency?

Next steps: once you confirm the preferred burst policy and term, I’ll prepare a commercial SOW and DocuSign packet for procurement.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-29T14:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + new model mix — rough numbers

Priya / Monica — quick internal note on GPU mix.

- For the XL-32k baseline, H100 provides memory headroom and better perf for long context; 8x H100 committed makes sense. However, for reranker inference the ops are lower-latency and can be handled by A100 equivalents if the customer wants a cost-sensitive option.
- Proposal: baseline commit = 6x H100 + 2x H100-spot (reserved but suspended for cost) + separate 2x A100 pool for reranker. Burst path = enable autoscale to 12 GPUs (H100 or H100+A100 mix based on availability).
- Price delta: H100-only baseline is ~18% more expensive than mixed; show both quotes in SOW. Include explicit quantization guidance (GPTQ-lite) and recommended KV cache config to avoid repeated prefix computation.

Also recommend adding a 30-day load validation window post-cutover to validate 32k tails and reranker latency; tie payment milestone to successful validation.

Ben
Director, Sales Engineering

From: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@mireo.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@mireo.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-15T11:32:00-08:00
Subject: SOW & commercial — committed plan for XL-32k + Reranker

Hi Asha / Liam — attaching the finalized SOW and two commercial options (H100-only and mixed H100/A100). Main points:

- Committed baseline: 8 H100-equivalent GPUs (config A: H100-only / config B: 6 H100 + 2 A100) with automatic burst to 12 GPU-equivalents for up to 12 hours/day.
- Reranker add-on: dedicated 2 A100-equivalent pool, with routed retry policy and capacity isolation to protect personalization SLOs.
- Performance SLAs: 99.9% p95 latency target for personalization endpoints at baseline; crediting model if missed.
- Pricing: two-tiered: committed monthly fee + usage overage at a reduced rate. See Pricing table (SOW).
- Rollout: phased canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) over 3 weeks, with KV cache priming and regression tests included.
- Validation: 30-day load validation; acceptance criteria documented in section 4.2.

Next action: please confirm preferred commercial config and we’ll send the DocuSign package. I’ve linked the HubSpot deal and included the throughput spreadsheet for your operations team.

Regards,
Priya

Attachments: Mireo_SOW_v3.pdf; throughput_calculations_mireo.xlsx; reranker_traffic_estimates.csv

--

From: Mireo Procurement <procurement@mireo.com>
To: priya_natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@mireo.com>, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@mireo.com>
Date: 2027-11-30T15:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOW & commercial — committed plan for XL-32k + Reranker

Hi Priya — thanks for the detailed SOW. Procurement has reviewed both commercial configs. We prefer Config B (6 H100 + 2 A100 baseline + 2 A100 reranker pool) as a cost compromise, with the burst to 12 GPU-equivalents included. A few clarifying requests before we sign:

1) Please add an explicit SLA credit table for availability and latency (not just description).
2) We need a section that states data residency controls and logging retention for audit (SOC2 evidence pointers).
3) Confirm that the 30-day validation window will not trigger overage billing if the validation generates bursts beyond baseline.

If you can provide a DocuSign packet with those edits by EOD Friday Nov 3, we’ll route for internal sign-off.

Thanks — we aim to have this in the November procurement packet.

Procurement (on behalf of Mireo Commerce)
procurement@mireo.com
